## Aircraft Details
- **Aircraft Model**: (e.g., ToLiss A350)
- **ICAO Code**: (check in X-Plane developer console: Special > Show Developer Console)
- **Parking Brake Dataref**: (confirm it uses `AirbusFBW/ParkBrake` or provide the correct dataref)

## Verification
- [ ] I have confirmed the aircraft's ICAO code
- [ ] I have confirmed the parking brake dataref name
- [ ] This is a ToLiss-developed aircraft

## Additional Context
Any other relevant information about why you'd like support for this aircraft.

## Note
The script currently supports: A319, A320, A20N, A21N, A321, A339, A346

If the aircraft uses the same `AirbusFBW/ParkBrake` dataref, adding support is a simple one-line change.
